allison (CEO): Thanks everyone — using this thread for finance/runway questions from today's all-hands. Drop anything you want clarified and Dan/Mike will chime in. I'll handle roadmap follow-ups.

sam (Eng IC): quick one — what's our current monthly burn and runway in months? :chart_with_downwards_trend:

dan (Finance Lead): Burn ~ $5.6M/month (net cash out). Runway ~ 15 months at current spend + existing credit facility. I'll upload a one-slide summary in a minute.

mike (CFO): FYI the forecast leans conservative on ARR growth and assumes we don't backfill non-critical roles in Q2.

sam (Eng IC): got it — is there a hiring freeze or replacement policy? can we replace ICs who leave?

mia (People Ops): not a blanket freeze. Hiring is prioritized. Replacements for critical roles (on-call, infra, revenue-impacting) are approved by People Ops + Eng manager + Finance. Non-critical roles paused until next review. We'll publish the rubric.

jordan (Head of Product): procurement question — have approval thresholds changed? can teams still sign vendors <$50k without exec sign-off?

dan (Finance Lead): short answer: thresholds updated last week. Quick guide below.

dan (Finance Lead): ```Procurement quick guide:
- < $25k: Team lead + Procurement review
- $25k - $100k: Finance + Legal review
- > $100k: Finance + Exec sign-off
```

sam (Eng IC): thanks. Also — what about one-off cloud spend spikes for experiments? Do we get pre-approval for bursts?

dan (Finance Lead): good question. We have a "spend-burst" fast-track: submit the spend-burst template in Confluence with an ops ticket and cost estimate. Finance will review within 48 hours for infra experiments; include rollback/cost caps.

allison (CEO): action items from this thread: Dan/Mike will post an anonymized runway slide and the procurement cheat sheet in #announcements. Mia will publish the hiring prioritization rubric in Confluence and ping managers. If you need expedited cloud approvals, tag #finance-ops + subject 'spend-burst' + estimate. :thumbsup:
